schema.content:
Table "Addresses" {
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "line_1" TEXT
  "line_2" TEXT
  "line_3" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "zip_postcode" TEXT
  "state_province_county" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
  "other_address_details" TEXT
}

Table "Courses" {
  "course_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "course_name" TEXT
  "course_description" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Degree_Programs" {
  "degree_program_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "department_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "degree_summary_name" TEXT
  "degree_summary_description" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Departments" {
  "department_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "department_name" TEXT
  "department_description" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Sections" {
  "section_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "course_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "section_name" TEXT
  "section_description" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Semesters" {
  "semester_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "semester_name" TEXT
  "semester_description" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Student_Enrolment" {
  "student_enrolment_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "degree_program_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "semester_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "student_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Student_Enrolment_Courses" {
  "student_course_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "course_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "student_enrolment_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Students" {
  "student_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "current_address_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "permanent_address_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "first_name" TEXT
  "middle_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "cell_mobile_number" TEXT
  "email_address" TEXT
  "ssn" TEXT
  "date_first_registered" TIMESTAMP
  "date_left" TIMESTAMP
  "other_student_details" TEXT
}

Table "Transcript_Contents" {
  "student_course_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "transcript_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Transcripts" {
  "transcript_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "transcript_date" TIMESTAMP
  "other_details" TEXT
}



Ref: "Degree_Programs"."department_id" > "Departments"."department_id"

Ref: "Sections"."course_id" > "Courses"."course_id"

Ref: "Students"."permanent_address_id" > "Addresses"."address_id"

Ref: "Students"."current_address_id" > "Addresses"."address_id"

Ref: "Student_Enrolment"."student_id" > "Students"."student_id"

Ref: "Student_Enrolment"."semester_id" > "Semesters"."semester_id"

Ref: "Student_Enrolment"."degree_program_id" > "Degree_Programs"."degree_program_id"

Ref: "Student_Enrolment_Courses"."student_enrolment_id" > "Student_Enrolment"."student_enrolment_id"

Ref: "Student_Enrolment_Courses"."course_id" > "Courses"."course_id"

Ref: "Transcript_Contents"."transcript_id" > "Transcripts"."transcript_id"

Ref: "Transcript_Contents"."student_course_id" > "Student_Enrolment_Courses"."student_course_id"
